tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the Energy North guides (electrical safety, EICR, landlords, consumer units, EV chargers, business premises). Returns titles, links and a short summary.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read the full text of one guide by its link (from search_guides or latest_guides).

tools.name: latest_guides
tools.description: List the newest guides, newest first.

tools.name: booking_info
tools.description: How to book an EICR, an EV charger survey or other electrical work with Energy North, with the right links and the areas covered.

labels.name: post_a_job
labels.description: Prepare a job for the person to post on Energy North: returns a link that opens the Energy North post-a-job form already filled with the trade, postcode and job details, so local verified tradespeople can reply. The person checks the details and posts it themselves; nothing is posted by this tool.

labels.name: list_trades
labels.description: List every trade on Energy North (80+), with its name, slug and page link.

labels.name: booking_info
labels.description: How to book an EICR, an EV charger survey or other electrical work with Energy North, with the right links and the areas covered.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_guide" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read the full text of one guide by its link (from search_guides or latest_guides)." → after: "Read the full text of one Energy North guide by its link."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
